Studio agent loop is implemented: agents get schema docs, the builder syncs external file edits, and generate-from-text/screenshot flows are wired.

### Delivered
1. **Agent schema** — `WIREFRAME_SCHEMA.md` and `wireframe.schema.json` (aligned with zod via tests). Copied into thread `Prototypes/` on save (`ensureWireframeAgentSchema` RPC). HTTP: `GET /prototype/wireframe-schema.md` and `GET /prototype/wireframe.schema.json`.

2. **Live sync** — While a saved file is open, poll `statWireframe` every 2s; valid external JSON applies as one undo step with toast + Undo; invalid edits show an error and are ignored; own writes are skipped via content SHA-256.

3. **Generate dialog** — Toolbar «Сгенерировать»: text (device + fidelity) or image (refs under `Prototypes/refs/`). Sends a composer prompt with absolute paths, creates/opens the wireframe, and adds a locked 30% trace `Image` for screenshot mode.

4. **`tryParseWireframe`** in `model.ts` for safe validation.

### Changed paths
- `src/studio/prototype/WIREFRAME_SCHEMA.md`, `wireframe.schema.json`
- `src/studio/prototype/agent-sync.ts`, `agent-sync.test.ts`, `agent-prompts.ts`, `agent-prompts.test.ts`, `agent-trace.ts`, `agent-generate-dialog.tsx`, `wireframe-schema.test.ts`
- `src/studio/prototype/model.ts`, `builder.tsx`, `toolbar.tsx`, `canvas.tsx`, `elements.tsx`
- `src/server/wireframe-agent.ts`
- `server.ts`
- `src/shared/i18n.ts`

### Verification
- `npx tsc --noEmit` — pass  
- `node --experimental-strip-types --test` (prototype tests + session + i18n) — **166 tests pass**

- 2026-10-17T21:58 prototype-containers: Prototype: dynamic panel states with content, repeater data grid, in-place container and group editing. Dynamic panels hold different content per state, repeaters render rows from editable data, and containers and groups are edited in place like in Axure.
- 2026-10-17T21:55 prototype-connectors: Prototype: connectors between shapes (Axure Connector tool). Flowchart shapes can be linked with connectors that follow the shapes when they move.
- 2026-10-17T21:51 prototype-context-menus: Prototype: unified mouse model and context menus in outline, pages, tabs, palette and canvas. Right-click opens a fitting context menu everywhere in the prototype builder, and left/right/double click behave the same across canvas, layers, pages and libraries.
- 2026-10-17T21:19 prototype-modifier-keys: Prototype: draw-by-drag tools and Shift/Alt/Cmd/Space modifiers like Figma/Axure/Photoshop. Shapes are drawn by dragging, and Shift, Alt, Cmd and Space behave as in Figma, Axure and Photoshop when drawing, resizing, moving and rotating.
- 2026-10-17T20:06 prototype-color-picker-fix: Prototype colour picker: effective defaults, tidy field row, rainbow hue and alpha tracks, portal popover with HEX/RGB. Choosing a colour is clear: the field shows the real colour, the picker has a rainbow hue bar, an alpha bar, HEX/RGB inputs and never runs off the panel.
- 2026-10-17T20:04 prototype-style-layout: Prototype Style panel: layout polish, no overlapping controls. The Style panel's controls never overlap and read clearly at any panel width.
- 2026-10-17T19:58 prototype-style-apply-fix: Fix: Style panel opacity (and other style fields) not applied on the canvas. Changing opacity or any other Style field immediately changes the element on the canvas, in PNG export and in Slides.
- 2026-10-17T19:56 prototype-align-icons: Prototype: real alignment icons in one row and proper tooltips. Alignment and distribution buttons use clear standard icons in one row with proper hover tooltips.
